<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{margin:0}</style></head><body><svg width="1080" height="600" viewBox="0 0 1080 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="1080" height="600" fill="#0f2440"/>
<circle cx="160" cy="120" r="3" fill="#7fe0ff"/><circle cx="320" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#7fe0ff"/><circle cx="900" cy="100" r="3" fill="#7fe0ff"/><circle cx="990" cy="220" r="2.5" fill="#7fe0ff"/><circle cx="120" cy="480" r="2.5" fill="#7fe0ff"/><circle cx="980" cy="500" r="3" fill="#7fe0ff"/>
<!-- server door -->
<g>
<rect x="180" y="140" width="300" height="380" rx="16" fill="#1c3a5e" stroke="#5b8fd6" stroke-width="5"/>
<rect x="210" y="180" width="240" height="300" rx="10" fill="#0f2440" stroke="#3e6aa8" stroke-width="3"/>
<g fill="#5b8fd6">
<rect x="236" y="210" width="188" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="236" y="244" width="188" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="236" y="278" width="188" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="236" y="312" width="188" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="236" y="346" width="188" height="14" rx="7"/>
</g>
<circle cx="330" cy="420" r="16" fill="#e05656"/>
</g>
<!-- big key -->
<g transform="translate(560,220) rotate(20)">
<circle cx="60" cy="0" r="48" fill="none" stroke="#ffd66b" stroke-width="20"/>
<rect x="100" y="-10" width="240" height="20" rx="8" fill="#ffd66b"/>
<rect x="300" y="0" width="18" height="44" rx="6" fill="#ffd66b"/>
<rect x="250" y="0" width="18" height="34" rx="6" fill="#ffd66b"/>
</g>
<!-- leaking files -->
<g font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC">
<rect x="770" y="120" width="60" height="80" rx="6" fill="#dbe7f5" transform="rotate(12 800 160)"/>
<polyline points="782,140 818,140" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(12 800 160)"/>
<polyline points="782,160 818,160" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(12 800 160)"/>
<polyline points="782,180 806,180" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(12 800 160)"/>
<rect x="840" y="200" width="60" height="80" rx="6" fill="#dbe7f5" transform="rotate(-8 870 240)"/>
<polyline points="852,220 888,220" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(-8 870 240)"/>
<polyline points="852,240 888,240" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(-8 870 240)"/>
<polyline points="852,260 874,260" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(-8 870 240)"/>
<rect x="790" y="330" width="60" height="80" rx="6" fill="#dbe7f5" transform="rotate(18 820 370)"/>
<polyline points="802,350 838,350" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(18 820 370)"/>
<polyline points="802,370 838,370" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(18 820 370)"/>
<polyline points="802,390 824,390" stroke="#5b7ba0" stroke-width="5" transform="rotate(18 820 370)"/>
<!-- flow arrows from door to files -->
<path d="M 470 300 Q 600 240 760 170" stroke="#e05656" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="12 10" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
<path d="M 470 330 Q 640 320 830 250" stroke="#e05656" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="12 10" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
<path d="M 470 360 Q 620 420 780 370" stroke="#e05656" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="12 10" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
<defs><marker id="arr" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 z" fill="#e05656"/></marker></defs>
</g>
<!-- checkmark whitelist badge -->
<g>
<rect x="70" y="40" width="300" height="64" rx="32" fill="#1c3a5e" stroke="#5b8fd6" stroke-width="3"/>
<circle cx="112" cy="72" r="18" fill="#4caf7d"/>
<polyline points="103,72 110,79 122,64" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
<text x="145" y="83" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="28" fill="#dbe7f5">白名单检查：放行</text>
</g>
<text x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="44" font-weight="bold" fill="#dbe7f5">门禁没坏，权限给得太宽了</text>
</svg></body></html>
